primaryChecks.text: They turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon. They gleaned five thousand men of them in the highways, and followed hard after them to Gidom, and struck two thousand men of them.
primaryChecks.nextContext: So that all who fell that day of Benjamin were twenty-five thousand men who drew the sword. All these were men of valor.
